ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

FilterGroup.description: JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString). Property filter group, e.g. {"type": "AND", "values": [{"type": "AND", "values": [{"key": "message", "type": "log", "operator": "icontains", "value": "timeout"}]}]}.

BlockedWindows.description: Blocked local time windows (project timezone) when the alert must not run. Overlapping windows are merged by PostHog. At most five.

Start.description: Start time HH:MM (24-hour, project timezone), inclusive.

End.description: End time HH:MM (24-hour, project timezone), exclusive. Each window must span at least 30 minutes.

Mode.description: `single` keeps one instance for the whole alert. `by_result_labels` keeps one instance per distinct value of the labels in Keys, each firing and resolving on its own (needs ThresholdOperator `above`).

Keys.description: Result labels whose values make a group, such as service_name or severity_text. Empty for `single`, required for `by_result_labels`. Changing them deletes existing instances.

MaxInstances.description: Most instances the alert keeps at once (1-100, default 100).

OnOverflow.description: What happens to groups past MaxInstances. `degrade_visible` (default) names how many were left out.
